facts.fact: The interior ministry's civil-status service page states that birth, marriage and death acts and the family civil-status sheet are issued at any commune or administrative annex across the national territory, whatever the commune of registration, the sheet immediately, and that a data-entry error is corrected by the civil registrar; it names no system or network (no date given, the page's published date is used).
facts.system: Délivrance des actes d'état civil auprès de toutes les communes

facts.fact: The interior ministry says civil-status acts are issued at 'all communes or administrative annexes' nationwide, without giving a count of communes or a figure for those connected (no date given, the page's published date is used).
facts.system: Délivrance des actes d'état civil auprès de toutes les communes

systems.system: Délivrance des actes d'état civil auprès de toutes les communes
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, des Collectivités locales et des Transports
systems.tiers: All communes and their administrative annexes; for acts of events abroad, all communes of Algiers wilaya and the chef-lieu communes of the other wilayas

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, des Collectivités locales et des Transports
systems.tiers: Online to residents: marriage appointments and requests to correct data-entry errors; acts are also delivered 'via internet'

note: The page states where acts are issued, not how commune offices are connected; the systems reading rests on any commune issuing any act. The ministry's 'all communes' comes with no count, so authorities is recorded as not-published.
